title: 27 November 2011: Paul McCartney live at Mediolanum Forum, Milan, Italy
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Mediolanum Forum in Milan, Italy, on 27 November 2011.

It was the 11th show of the On The Run Tour, which lasted for 37 dates between July 2011 and November 2012.

As with his previous show at the Unipol Arena in Bologna, new additions to the setlist were the Badfinger song ‘Come And Get It’, and a medley of ‘The Word’ and ‘All You Need Is Love’ which closed with a chorus of ‘She Loves You’.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
